statement: Linux v7.3 hid-steam matches 28de:1303 with HID_BLUETOOTH_DEVICE and STEAM_QUIRK_IBEX plus STEAM_QUIRK_BLE. The IBEX path accepts a sole BLE HID interface independent of USB interface numbering. It initializes connected state without the receiver-only wireless-status query. Kernel lines 1589-1631, 1735-1833, 2751-2761.
